sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Inhale, Tactile), Earth Release, Wind Release

system.description:
You collect your Dust particles into a single point in the air, before you create a magnificent structure of geometric branching spikes that shoot randomly in every direction covering every possible angle and vector. All creatures within the affected area must make a Dexterity saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature takes half of 6d6 earth damage.

Success: Affected creature takes half of 6d6 earth damage and are Staggered.

Failure: Affected creatures takes 6d6 earth damage are Dazed and Staggered.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creature takes 8d6 earth damage and are Stunned.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the size of the area by +10-feet.
